cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus

import numpy as np

# Seed data
# seed42: hardcoded (Table 1 canonical, already alpha-tiebroken)
# seed123: raw from results.json (n=600)
# seed456: raw from results.json on westd-30973 (n=600)

seeds = [
    {'seed': 42,  'sc': 72.50, 'sica': 65.00, 'p': 6.27e-08, 'hardcoded': True},
    {'seed': 123, 'sc': 428/600*100, 'sica': 385/600*100, 'p': 0.000007},
    {'seed': 456, 'sc': 430/600*100, 'sica': 397/600*100, 'p': 0.000176},
    {'seed': 789, 'sc': 427/600*100, 'sica': 399/600*100, 'p': 0.000914},  # SICA alpha-corrected
]

# Compute deltas
for s in seeds:
    s['delta'] = s['sica'] - s['sc']

# Print raw values
for s in seeds:
    print(f"Seed {s['seed']}: SC={s['sc']:.4f}, SICA={s['sica']:.4f}, Δ={s['delta']:.4f}, p={s['p']:.6f}")

# Compute mean ± std
sc_vals = [s['sc'] for s in seeds]
sica_vals = [s['sica'] for s in seeds]
delta_vals = [s['delta'] for s in seeds]

sc_mean, sc_std = np.mean(sc_vals), np.std(sc_vals, ddof=1)
sica_mean, sica_std = np.mean(sica_vals), np.std(sica_vals, ddof=1)
delta_mean, delta_std = np.mean(delta_vals), np.std(delta_vals, ddof=1)

print(f"\nMean±Std: SC={sc_mean:.2f}±{sc_std:.2f}, SICA={sica_mean:.2f}±{sica_std:.2f}, Δ={delta_mean:.2f}±{delta_std:.2f}")

# Format p-value
def fmt_p(p):
    if p < 0.001:
        return "$<$.001", "***"
    elif p < 0.01:
        return f".{p*1000:.0f}", "**"
    elif p < 0.05:
        return f".{p*100:.0f}", "*"
    else:
        return f".{p*100:.0f}", ""

# Generate LaTeX
lines = []
lines.append("% LLaMA-3.1-8B × ProofWriter-600, 4 seeds")
lines.append("\\midrule")
lines.append("\\multicolumn{6}{l}{\\textit{LLaMA-3.1-8B $\\times$ ProofWriter-600}} \\\\")

for s in seeds:
    p_str, sig = fmt_p(s['p'])
    delta_abs = abs(s['delta'])
    delta_sign = "$-$" if s['delta'] < 0 else "$+$"
    line = f"{s['seed']}  & {s['sc']:.2f} & {s['sica']:.2f} & {delta_sign}{delta_abs:.2f} & {p_str} & {sig} \\\\"
    lines.append(line)

lines.append(f"Mean$\\pm$Std & {sc_mean:.2f}$\\pm${sc_std:.2f} & {sica_mean:.2f}$\\pm${sica_std:.2f} & {delta_sign_mean}{abs(delta_mean):.2f}$\\pm${delta_std:.2f} & & \\\\")

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("LaTeX output:")
print("="*80)
for l in lines:
    print(l)

# Write to file
with open("results/multi_seed_llama_table.tex", "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print(f"\nSaved to results/multi_seed_llama_table.tex")
